title: Dash
symptom: After installing 3.1.0.3-dev-b, the user could not activate a new Dash pod after deactivating the old one; the Activate Pod button was present but not functional. The user had to revert to dev-a variant where it worked.
fix: The issue was fixed in a commit (7543f3f11834bfb6a059448e6cc8fb9e11ea9bce) and confirmed fixed by a maintainer.
evidence_quote: i hope activation was fixed in https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/7543f3f11834bfb6a059448e6cc8fb9e11ea9bce
